arxiv-1606-03379.title: A mixed finite element approximation for Darcy-Forchheimer flows of slightly compressible fluids
arxiv-1606-03379.creator: Thinh Kieu
arxiv-1606-03379.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the generalized Forchheimer flows for slightly compressible fluids in porous media. Using Muskat’s and Ward’s general form of Forchheimer equations, we describe the flow of a single-phase fluid in ℝ d , d ≥ 2 \mathbb{R}^{d},d\geq 2 by a nonlinear degenerate system of density and momentum.

arxiv-2104-03317.title: Binary-Stripped Stars as Core-Collapse Supernovae Progenitors
arxiv-2104-03317.creator: David Vartanyan, Eva Laplace, Mathieu Renzo, Ylva Götberg, Adam Burrows, Selma E. de Mink
arxiv-2104-03317.description: Abstract Most massive stars experience binary interactions in their lifetimes that can alter both the surface and core structure of the stripped star with significant effects on their ultimate fate as core-collapse supernovae. However, core-collapse supernovae simulations to date have focused almost exclusively on the evolution of single stars.

arxiv-2104-04781.title: Boosted Embeddings for Time-Series Forecasting
arxiv-2104-04781.creator: Sankeerth Rao Karingula, Nandini Ramanan, Rasool Tahmasbi, Mehrnaz Amjadi, Deokwoo Jung, Ricky Si, Charanraj Thimmisetty, Luisa Polania Cabrera, Marjorie Sayer, Claudionor Nunes Coelho Jr
arxiv-2104-04781.description: Abstract Time-series forecasting is a fundamental task emerging from diverse data-driven applications. Many advanced autoregressive methods such as ARIMA were used to develop forecasting models. Recently, deep learning based methods such as DeepAR, NeuralProphet, Seq2Seq have been explored for the time-series forecasting problem. In this paper, we propose a novel time-series forecast model, DeepGB .

arxiv-2305-15308.title: Beyond the disk: EUV coronagraphic observations of the Extreme Ultraviolet Imager on board Solar Orbiter
arxiv-2305-15308.creator: F. Auchère ,, D. Berghmans, C. Dumesnil, J.-P. Halain, R. Mercier, P. Rochus, F. Delmotte, S. François, A. Hermans, V. Hervier, E. Kraaikamp, E. Meltchakov, G. Morinaud, A. Philippon, P. J. Smith, K. Stegen, C. Verbeeck, X. Zhang, V. Andretta, L. Abbo, E. Buchlin, F. Frassati, S. Gissot, M. Gyo, L.
arxiv-2305-15308.description: Abstract Context. Most observations of the solar corona beyond 2 R ⊙ consist of broadband visible light imagery carried out with coronagraphs. The associated diagnostics mainly consist of kinematics and derivations of the electron number density. While the measurement of the properties of emission lines can provide crucial additional diagnostics of the coronal plasma (temperatures, velocities, abundances, etc.

arxiv-2407-17538.title: Higher order mass aggregation terms in a nonlinear predator-prey model maintain limit cycle stability in Saturn’s F ring
arxiv-2407-17538.creator: Omar El Deeb
arxiv-2407-17538.description: Abstract We consider a generic higher order mass aggregation term for interactions between particles exhibiting oscillatory clumping and disaggregation behavior in the F ring of Saturn, using a novel predator-prey model that relates the mean mass aggregate (prey) and the square of the relative dispersion velocity (predator) of the interacting particles.

arxiv-2411-08456.title: The Sylvester question in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} : convex sets with a flat floor Thanks: The authors were partially supported by the ANR projects CartesEtPlus (ANR-23-CE48-0018) and 3DMaps (ANR-20-CE48-0018)
arxiv-2411-08456.creator: Jean-François Marckert, Ludovic Morin
arxiv-2411-08456.description: Abstract Pick n n independent random points U 1 , … , U n U_{1},\ldots,U_{n} uniformly in a compact convex set K K of ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} with volume 1, and let P K ( d ) ​ ( n ) P^{(d)}_{K}(n) be the probability that these points are in convex position.

arxiv-2412-15848.title: Stalling in Space: Attractor Analysis for any Algorithm
arxiv-2412-15848.creator: Sarah L. Thomson 1, Quentin Renau 1, Diederick Vermetten 2, Emma Hart 1, Niki van Stein 2, Anna V. Kononova 2
arxiv-2412-15848.description: Abstract Network-based representations of fitness landscapes have grown in popularity in the past decade; this is probably because of growing interest in explainability for optimisation algorithms. Local optima networks (LONs) have been especially dominant in the literature and capture an approximation of local optima and their connectivity in the landscape.

arxiv-2501-07262.title: OblivCDN: A Practical Privacy-preserving CDN with Oblivious Content Access
arxiv-2501-07262.creator: Viet Vo, Shangqi Lai, Xingliang Yuan, Surya Nepal, Qi Li
arxiv-2501-07262.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Viet Vo, Shangqi Lai, Xingliang Yuan, Surya Nepal, Qi Li. Content providers increasingly utilise Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) to enhance users’ content download experience. However, this deployment scenario raises significant security concerns regarding content confidentiality and user privacy due to the involvement of third-party providers. Prior proposals using private information retrieval (PIR) and oblivious RAM (ORAM) have proven impractical due to high computation and communication costs, as well as integration challenges within distributed CDN architectures.

arxiv-2504-20758.title: Influence network reconstruction from discrete time-series of count data modelled by multidimensional Hawkes processes
arxiv-2504-20758.creator: Naratip Santitissadeekorn, Martin Short, David J. B. Lloyd
arxiv-2504-20758.description: Abstract Identifying key influencers from time series data without a known prior network structure is a challenging problem in various applications, from crime analysis to social media. While much work has focused on event-based time series (timestamp) data, fewer methods address count data, where event counts are recorded in fixed intervals.

arxiv-2505-16260.title: Small-to-Large Generalization: Data Influences Models Consistently Across Scale
arxiv-2505-16260.creator: Alaa Khaddaj, Logan Engstrom, Aleksander Mądry
arxiv-2505-16260.description: Abstract Choice of training data distribution greatly influences model behavior. Yet, in large-scale settings, precisely characterizing how changes in training data affects predictions is often difficult due to model training costs. Current practice is to instead extrapolate from scaled down, inexpensive-to-train proxy models. However, changes in data do not influence smaller and larger models identically.

arxiv-2509-06258.title: Doubly heavy hadron production in ultraperipheral collisions
arxiv-2509-06258.creator: Shi-Yuan Li
arxiv-2509-06258.description: Abstract The inclusive production of pseudoscalar heavy quarkoniua ( η c , η b , B c \eta_{c},\,\eta_{b},\,B_{c} ), double heavy baryon Ξ Q ​ Q ′ \Xi_{QQ^{\prime}} ( Q ( ′ ) = c , b Q^{(\prime)}=c,\,b quarks) and tetraquark T Q ​ Q T_{QQ} in heavy ion ultraperipheral collisions (UPCs) are studied.

arxiv-2510-08427.title: A convergent hierarchy of spectral gap certificates for qubit Hamiltonians
arxiv-2510-08427.creator: Sujit Rao
arxiv-2510-08427.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sujit Rao. We give a convergent hierarchy of SDP certificates for bounding the spectral gap of local qubit Hamiltonians from below. Our approach is based on the NPA hierarchy applied to a polynomially-sized system of constraints defining the universal enveloping algebra of the Lie algebra 𝔰 ​ 𝔲 ​ ( 2 n ) \mathfrak{su}(2^{n}) , as well as additional constraints which put restrictions on the corresponding representations of the algebra.

arxiv-2601-21535.title: Sparsity for isotropic spherical random fields Thanks: Both authors are associated to INdAM (Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica “Francesco Severi”) and the group GNAMPA; they are supported by the PRIN project GRAFIA (CUP: E53D23005530006) and MUR Departement of Excellence Programme 2023-2027 MatM
arxiv-2601-21535.creator: Giacomo Greco, Domenico Marinucci
arxiv-2601-21535.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Giacomo Greco, Domenico Marinucci. We introduce a simple representation for isotropic spherical random fields and we discuss how it allows to discuss different notions of sparsity under isotropy. We also show how a suitable construction of sparse fields can mimic well the angular power spectrum and the polyspectra of some popular non-Gaussian fields, at the same time allowing for computationally efficient simulation algorithms.

gao-gaoreports-gao-08-456t.title: Aviation Security: Transportation Security Administration Has Strengthened Planning to Guide Investments in Key Aviation Security Programs, but More Work Remains
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-456t.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-456t.description: Aviation Security: Transportation Security Administration Has Strengthened Planning to Guide Investments in Key Aviation Security Programs, but More Work Remains (2008).

jack-sheppard.title: Jack Sheppard
jack-sheppard.creator: Ainsworth, William Harrison
jack-sheppard.description: While Jack Sheppard seems marked from birth for a terrible end, his wit and charm might just be able to cheat fate. Fate, however, seems eager to cheat him out of an honest living, when Jack begins visiting the notorious Black Lion, drinking den of the worst criminals in London.

pmc-11410308.title: TREM2, a critical activator of pyroptosis, mediates the anti-tumor effects of piceatannol in uveal melanoma cells via caspase 3/GSDME pathway
pmc-11410308.creator: Xudong Jiu, Wenjie Li, Yang Liu, Lin Liu, Hong Lu
pmc-11410308.description: Uveal melanoma (UM) is the most prevalent type of primary intraocular malignancy and is prone to metastasize, particularly to the liver. However, due to the poor understanding of the pathogenesis of UM, effective therapeutic approaches are lacking. As a phenolic compound extracted from grapes, piceatannol (PIC) exhibits anti-cancer properties.

pmc-11455435.title: 5141 Metastatic Adrenocortical Carcinoma
pmc-11455435.creator: Nida Anwaar
pmc-11455435.description: Disclosure: N. Anwaar: None.Adrenocortical carcinomas are rare and frequently aggressive tumors that may be functional (hormone secreting) and cause Cushing's syndrome and/or virilization or nonfunctional and present as an abdominal mass or as an incidental finding. We report a case of a 72-year-old lady who was presented to the ER with chest pain and elevated blood pressure.

pmc-11490894.title: Barriers to Extracting and Harmonizing Glaucoma Testing Data: Gaps, Shortcomings, and the Pursuit of FAIRness
pmc-11490894.creator: Niloofar Radgoudarzi, Shahin Hallaj, Michael V. Boland, Brian Stagg, Sophia Y. Wang, Benjamin Xu, Swarup S. Swaminathan, Eric N. Brown, Aiyin Chen, Catherine Q. Sun, Dilru C. Amarasekera, Jonathan S. Myers, Murtaza Saifee, William Halfpenny, Keri Dirkes, Linda Zangwill, Kerry E. Goetz, Michelle Hrib
pmc-11490894.description: nd is the leading cause of irreversible blindness globally with nearly 95 million people affected by the disease worldwide.1,2 As the global population ages, the prevalence of glaucoma is anticipated to increase in the coming decades.3,4 The significant prevalence and elevated incidence of blindness due to glaucoma raises the condition as a public health concern.

pmc-11503567.title: Relationship between respiratory function assessed by spirometry and mild cognitive impairment among community‐dwelling older adults
pmc-11503567.creator: Yuka Tachibana, Kayo Godai, Mai Kabayama, Yuya Akagi, Michiko Kido, Mariko Hosokawa, Hiroshi Akasaka, Yoichi Takami, Koichi Yamamoto, Saori Yasumoto, Yukie Masui, Kazunori Ikebe, Yasumichi Arai, Tatsuro Ishizaki, Yasuyuki Gondo, Kei Kamide
pmc-11503567.description: AimAging is a major cause of cognitive dysfunction. It has also been reported that respiratory function may influence cognitive dysfunction. However, few studies have examined the relationship between cognitive function and respiratory function among community‐dwelling older adults. This study aims to determine the relationship between respiratory function, assessed using spirometry, and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) in community‐dwelling older adults.

pmc-11608703.title: Exploring the link between SIRT1 gene variants and depression comorbidity in type 2 diabetes
pmc-11608703.creator: Yingxia He, Qinqin Wu, Ziwei Yin, Yi Zeng, Ningyu Xia, Hong Zhu
pmc-11608703.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aims to (1) analyze the clinical characteristics and risk factors of patients with type 2 diabetes and comorbid depression and (2) explore the association between SIRT1 gene single-nucleotide polymorphism sites and this comorbidity.

pmc-11725064.title: Strategic Management of Valve Infolding in Evolut TAVR Procedures: Enhancing Outcomes and Ensuring Patient Safety
pmc-11725064.creator: Rajendra Shah, Olayiwola Bolaji, Yasemin Bahar, Renu Sah, Anderson Chukwuka Ariaga, Timir K Paul, Rajeev L Narayan, M Chadi Alraies
pmc-11725064.description: Transcatheter aortic valve repair (TAVR) presents a minimally invasive alternative to traditional surgical valve replacement, albeit not without its own set of complications. A rare complication is the infolding of the self-expanding valve, which can precipitate cardiac arrest. The estimated incidence rate of this complication stands at 1.6%.

pmc-12521779.title: Peripheral Precocious Puberty Due to Autonomous Gonadal Activation: A Multicenter Experience
pmc-12521779.creator: Sushil Yewale, Vaman Khadilkar, Nikhil Shah, Shalmi Mehta, Hemchand K Prasad, Chirantap Oza, Aniket Kumbhojkar, Ruma Deshpande, Ankita Maheshwari, Anuradha Khadilkar
pmc-12521779.description: Introduction: Peripheral precocious puberty (PP) is far less commonly encountered compared to central precocious puberty (CPP) in pediatric endocrine practice. Long-standing non-diagnosis may cause rapidly advancing bone age, leading to CPP and resultant short stature. We aimed to report the clinical profile and current Indian experience in the management of children with peripheral PP due to autonomous gonadal activation.

pmc-12564761.title: Application of Modulators of Ca2+-Activated Big-Conductance Potassium Channels Against Cd2+-Induced Cytotoxicity: A Study on Two Rat Cell Lines, PC12 and AS-30D
pmc-12564761.creator: Elena A Belyaeva, Tatyana V Sokolova, Toshiyuki Kaji
pmc-12564761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As we found earlier, paxilline (a Penicillium paxilli mycotoxin and blocker of Ca2+-activated big-conductance potassium channels, BK(Ca)s) attenuated Cd2+-induced cytotoxic effects, whereas BK(Ca) activators (NS004, NS1619) and Cd2+ were able to induce apoptosis, which was enhanced when used together. In this work, molecular mechanisms underlying the aforementioned effects were studied using two rat cell lines, PC12 and AS-30D, flow cytometry, and spectrofluorometric and polarographic techniques.

pmc-12610569.title: Value-Added Carp Roe Salad Supplemented with Orange Carrot Pomace Powder
pmc-12610569.creator: Roxana Nicoleta Rațu, Genica-Florina Oncică, Florina Stoica, Oana Emilia Constantin, Nicoleta Stănciuc, Iuliana Aprodu, Doina Georgeta Andronoiu, Marija Banožić, Nada Ćujić Nikolić, Gabriela Râpeanu
pmc-12610569.description: Carrot pomace is the solid residue left after juice extraction from carrots. Carrot pomace, typically seen as waste, is gaining recognition for its sustainability and potential to mitigate food waste while offering essential nutrients (phenolics, carotenoids, and β-carotene), which are recognized for their nutraceutical effects and health benefits.

pmc-12663808.title: Prostate cancer diagnostics: the independent and combined roles of SelectMDx and mpMRI
pmc-12663808.creator: Petrino-Cristian Călinoiu, Ovidiu-Cătălin Nechita, Daniel Bădescu, Cristian-Valentin Toma, Ştefan Raşcu, Razvan-Cosmin Petca, Justin Aurelian, Traian Constantin, Viorel Jinga
pmc-12663808.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionProstate cancer is a major global health concern, affecting one in every eight men over the course of their lives. Early detection and precise risk stratification are essential for distinguishing indolent types from aggressive cancer that necessitates immediate treatment. Prostate-specific antigen (PSA), although its widespread use in prostate cancer screening, lacks specificity, resulting in unnecessary biopsies and overtreatment of clinically insignificant malignancies.

pmc-12821628.title: Resting-State EEG Correlates of Childhood Maltreatment and Depression: Potential Neurophysiological Links and Future Research Directions
pmc-12821628.creator: Christopher B. Watson, Christopher F. Sharpley, Vicki Bitsika
pmc-12821628.description: The experience of childhood maltreatment (CM) increases the risk for depressive disorders by two-and-a-half times across the lifespan. Although stress system and immunological models offer some explanation of this vulnerability, further investigation is required to understand the underlying neurophysiological mechanisms and identify potential biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-13199056.title: CancerOmicsStudio (CoS): a web server for integrative and interpretable analysis of multi-omics cancer data
pmc-13199056.creator: Chenqi Liao, Rui Dou, Danyang Sun, Chengxiu Hu, Hui Hu, Long Cheng, Yuzhong Xu, Xiong Wang, Prof Jianlin Cheng
pmc-13199056.description: MotivationLarge-scale omics resources, including The Cancer Genome Atlas, Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer, and the Cancer Dependency Map, have become essential for cancer research. However, these datasets are distributed across different platforms, formats and analysis frameworks, which limits their practical use by researchers without extensive computational expertise.

pmc-13464244.title: New Diagnosis of Atrial Fibrillation in Pregnancy
pmc-13464244.creator: Manasa Jasti, Cornelia R Graves, Stephen R Clendenin, Hannah L Fish-Trotter
pmc-13464244.description: Atrial fibrillation (AF) during pregnancy is associated with increased maternal risk. New-diagnosis AF in pregnancy presents several complex clinical dilemmas, including decisions regarding stroke prophylaxis, the risk of AF recurrence, and the need for long-term anticoagulation beyond pregnancy. Evidence to inform these decisions is sparse, and existing risk-stratification tools have not been validated in pregnant populations.

pmc-13548616.title: Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-derived TSG-6 regulates microglial pyroptosis and alleviates bone cancer pain by inhibiting the NLRP3 inflammasome
pmc-13548616.creator: Danyang Xu, Mengna Jiang, Hao Ming, Jing Zhang, Yunqi Li, Ping Wu, Qingping Wen

pmc-13568034.title: A Systematic Study of Rotation Robustness in Remote Sensing Image Segmentation: RICM Versus Random Rotation Augmentation
pmc-13568034.creator: Zhanpeng Huang, Haihui Wang, Yuhang Wang, Longbin Yu, Xinzhi Cao
pmc-13568034.description: This study presents a systematic comparison of two dominant paradigms for improving rotation robustness in remote sensing semantic segmentation: rotation-invariant architectural modules (represented by Rotation-Invariant Channel Mapping, RICM) and random rotation data augmentation. Despite both approaches being widely adopted, a fair and side-by-side evaluation under unified experimental conditions remains lacking.

pmc-13610366.title: Balance Control and Its Correlation with Functional Capacity in People with Post-Tuberculosis Lung Disease
pmc-13610366.creator: Pedro Henrique Perpetuo de Lima Silva, Isabelle da Nobrega Ferreira, Alessandro dos Santos Beserra, Nielza Moreira de Souza, Estephane Ramos de Souza Penna, Alícia Sales Carneiro, Walter Costa, Bruna Cuoco Provenzano, Ana Paula Santos, Agnaldo José Lopes
pmc-13610366.description: Background: Because falls can lead to loss of autonomy in individuals with post-tuberculosis lung disease (iwPTLD), assessing fall risk is crucial for reducing the likelihood of fractures and preventing the decline of physical function. This cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate balance control (BC) in iwPTLD and correlate it with functional capacity during exertion (FCE), pulmonary function, muscle strength, and fatigue.

pmc-13621883.title: Transforming Brain Organoids Into Functional Platforms: Convergence of Engineering, Imaging, AI, and Ethics
pmc-13621883.creator: Aishwarya Pantula, Kaustubh Joshi, Swarangi Samant, Greta Babakhanova, Annie Kathuria
